mapper.select: SELECT * FROM emoji WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY hot_score DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emoji WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emoji WHERE category = #{category}
mapper.update: UPDATE emoji SET hot_score = hot_score + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE emoji SET hot_score = FLOOR(hot_score * 0.9) WHERE hot_score > 10
